reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本主模型补齐视觉能力：在对话中提供 `vision` 工具并自动发现/选择已配置的多模态模型处理图片文件路径，再将识别结果以文本返回，整体定位为图片工具化处理插件。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DeepSeek Harness 的纯文本主模型提供 `vision` 工具，通过已配置的多模态模型将图片文件路径解析为文本描述。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a `vision` tool for DeepSeek Harness text-only models, converting image file paths into text descriptions via configured multimodal models.

capabilities: Local image-to-text conversion via file path input
Automatic routing from text-only model context to configured multimodal providers
Model auto-discovery and validation for image-capable models

reasons.code: README states the plugin adds a `vision` tool with `file_path` (required) and `instruction` (optional) parameters.
README explains automatic discovery of configured image-capable models and delegation of image handling away from text-only primary models.
README describes automatic hiding/restoring of `read_image` behavior to enforce the `vision` path for text-only models.
package.json identifies the project as a DSH plugin with a bundle patch entry, confirming host integration and execution within the DSH environment.
